statement: The FOMC decision announced 2026-09-16 raises the federal funds target range above the range in effect on 2026-09-15.
resolution: True if the Federal Reserve implementation note or FRED series DFEDTARU shows a target range effective after the 2026-09-16 decision higher than the range in effect on 2026-09-15; false if unchanged or lower.
failure_condition: The federal funds target range effective after the 2026-09-16 decision is unchanged from or lower than the range in effect on 2026-09-15.

statement: At least one commercial tanker in the Persian Gulf or Gulf of Oman sustains physical damage from an attack between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: True if the vessel operator or flag state confirms attack damage to a named tanker in those waters between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-30 and at least one wire service carries the confirmation.
failure_condition: No commercial tanker in the Persian Gulf or Gulf of Oman sustains operator- or flag-state-confirmed attack damage between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-30.

statement: A lapse in United States federal appropriations begins on 2026-10-01, with agency shutdown procedures taking effect that day.
resolution: True if no enacted appropriations act or continuing resolution covers 2026-10-01 and OMB directs agencies to execute shutdown plans that day; Congress.gov enacted-legislation records govern.
failure_condition: Enacted appropriations or a continuing resolution covers 2026-10-01 and no agency executes OMB-directed shutdown procedures that day.

statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog carries at least 8 entries with a dateAdded value between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: True if a fetch of the CISA KEV catalog on or after the deadline shows 8 or more entries whose dateAdded falls between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-30 inclusive.
failure_condition: Fewer than 8 KEV entries carry a dateAdded value between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-30 inclusive.

statement: ICE Brent crude front-month futures settle at or above 95.00 USD per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-09-01 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: True if any official ICE Brent front-month daily settlement price between 2026-09-01 and 2026-10-30 is at or above 95.00 USD; exchange settlement records govern.
failure_condition: Every ICE Brent front-month daily settlement between 2026-09-01 and 2026-10-30 is below 95.00 USD.

statement: The Nepal government confirmed death toll from the August 2026 flood disaster reaches at least 300 at any point between 2026-08-31 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: True if Nepali government statements carried by at least two international news agencies place the confirmed dead at 300 or more on any date between 2026-08-31 and 2026-10-30.
failure_condition: The cumulative Nepal government confirmed death toll remains below 300 through 2026-10-30.

statement: The Massachusetts murder trial of Lindsay Clancy concludes with a jury verdict or a declared mistrial between 2026-08-31 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: True if the Plymouth County Superior Court docket or at least two national outlets record a jury verdict returned or mistrial declared between 2026-08-31 and 2026-10-30.
failure_condition: As of the deadline the trial has produced neither a jury verdict nor a declared mistrial between 2026-08-31 and 2026-10-30.

statement: Commercial shipping transit through the Strait of Hormuz is suspended for at least 48 consecutive hours at any point between 2026-09-01 and 2026-10-31.
resolution: True if at least two international wire services, citing shipping authorities or maritime insurers, report a suspension of commercial Strait of Hormuz transits lasting 48 or more consecutive hours between 2026-09-01 and 2026-10-31.
failure_condition: Commercial Strait of Hormuz transits continue between 2026-09-01 and 2026-10-31 without any suspension reaching 48 consecutive hours.

statement: Democratic candidates win at least 218 seats in the United States House of Representatives in the general election held 2026-11-03.
resolution: True if Associated Press race calls as of the deadline show Democratic candidates winning 218 or more House seats from the 2026-11-03 general election.
failure_condition: Democratic candidates win fewer than 218 House seats in the 2026-11-03 election as called by the deadline.

statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog adds at least one entry with vendorProject Cisco and a dateAdded value between 2026-09-01 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: True if the KEV catalog contains an entry whose vendorProject value is Cisco and whose dateAdded falls between 2026-09-01 and 2026-11-30 inclusive.
failure_condition: No KEV entry with vendorProject Cisco carries a dateAdded between 2026-09-01 and 2026-11-30.
